correctness.rationale: Exact master-equation reduction and stationary resolvent yield a positive normalized X-state for every J,a,b,r>0. Its competing concurrence branch is ruled out by a symbolic all-positive-monomial certificate Q. The remaining branch sign is determined by a degree-eight polynomial with P0..P2<0, P5..P8>0, and P3>=0 forcing P4>0; Descartes rule yields exactly one positive root, with opposite endpoint signs. The exact algebra and full independent 16x16 Liouvillian have been replayed via embedded checker.py (880 numerical assertions in addition to exact symbolic identities).

evidence: Kulkarni–Majumdar (2023), arXiv:2307.07485, Secs. II–III, provides the renewal stationary matrix for CLOSED unitary dynamics, with no local Lindblad noise.

Hartmann–Dür–Briegel (2007), arXiv:quant-ph/0703138, Secs. 2.3–2.4 and 3.2, applies separately acting ONE-QUBIT reset terms and distinct dissipative generators; it does not supply a joint reset plus the mixed-axis Pauli generator.
Rose et al. (2018), arXiv:1806.01298, develops the general quantum stationary-reset resolvent; this already implies how to set up, not how to factor, the present entanglement sign polynomial.
General 2018 resolvent covers stationary *existence and calculation method* but does not state the eighth-degree polynomial or its sign classification.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Prior general frameworks determine a resolvent in principle and do not, without a nontrivial elimination and sign argument, imply this exact all-positive-parameter concurrence classification. originality.rationale: Specific global reset model with XX coupling and unequal Pauli error axes is not covered by the inspected sources: two X channels commute with XX and possess a J^2>ab feasibility obstruction, whereas the present X and Z channels do not and yield high-reset concurrence 2J/r; the pure-dephasing pair-conversion model freezes spectator populations. The full exact single-onset classification with an eighth-degree threshold was not identified. Generic resetting and earlier qualitative entanglement phenomena are expressly excluded from the novelty claim.
residual_risks: The inspected sources are bounded; a general unindexed channel-theoretic classification may subsume the result.
The sign polynomial may be implicit in a broader all-channel stationary-state resolvent, even though no dominating explicit comparison was identified.
Independent publication-priority review was not performed.

value.rationale: The all-rate classification answers the natural physical control question of whether mismatched Pauli-error axes admit entanglement rescue under joint resets. Unlike the established commuting same-axis model, the anticommuting second noise channel removes a previously sharp geometric-mean feasibility obstruction for every fixed finite noise pair, with an exact positive single-onset interval. The unique polynomial boundary is useful for model calibration and control and not simply an evaluated textbook limit.
